title: Why Japanese People NEVER Tip
description: You tip your waiter 20% and feel generous. In Japan? That same tip is a huge mistake. Here's the wild reason why.

sections.narration: You just had the BEST sushi of your entire life. In Tokyo. It was unreal.
sections.visual_notes: Boy sitting at sushi bar, eyes wide, plate of colorful sushi in front of him, chopsticks in hand, sparkles around food

sections.narration: So you slap a big tip on the table. Twenty bucks. You feel like a HERO.
sections.visual_notes: Boy placing money bills on the table with a proud grin, thumbs up, money fanned out

sections.narration: And the waiter RUNS after you. Down the street. Waving your money.
sections.visual_notes: Waiter in apron running down a street, arm stretched out holding money, boy turning around looking puzzled

sections.narration: Not because you overpaid. Because you just made a HUGE mistake. To his FACE.
sections.visual_notes: Waiter standing with arms crossed looking serious, money on the ground between them, boy with sweat drops and wide eyes

sections.narration: See in Japan, amazing service isn't a bonus. It's the MINIMUM. It's called omotenashi.
sections.visual_notes: Waiter bowing perfectly with a tray balanced on one hand, glowing Japanese text showing omotenashi, sparkle effects

sections.narration: Every waiter, every taxi driver, every convenience store worker — they give you EVERYTHING. Every time. No exceptions.
sections.visual_notes: Three panels: taxi driver opening door, store worker wrapping a package with a bow, waiter pouring tea with perfect posture

sections.narration: So when you tip? You're basically saying — wow, I didn't think you'd actually be GOOD at your job.
sections.visual_notes: Boy holding out money with a naive smile, waiter with a giant question mark above head looking puzzled

sections.narration: That's like handing a doctor five bucks and going — thanks for doing your job!
sections.visual_notes: Boy handing a coin to a doctor in white coat, doctor staring at the coin with a blank expression, speech bubble with question mark

sections.narration: But HERE'S the part that blew my mind.
sections.visual_notes: Boy with explosion of colorful sparks around his head, lightbulb above, dramatic zoom lines radiating outward

sections.narration: Japanese workers don't earn LESS because there's no tipping. They earn a LIVING WAGE. The menu price already covers fair pay.
sections.visual_notes: Japanese menu with price circled showing equals sign to happy waiter with full wallet, green checkmark above

sections.narration: Meanwhile in America? Servers make TWO DOLLARS an hour. And hope that you're feeling generous.
sections.visual_notes: American waiter looking down holding two tiny coins, empty tip jar next to him, rain cloud above his head

sections.narration: So which system is actually broken? Japan figured this out CENTURIES ago. Your grandma's rules — finally explained.
sections.visual_notes: Split screen: left side Japan flag with happy waiter and thumbs up, right side question marks and thinking face, CuriousAsian logo at bottom
